purpose: One server-side projection for reader pages and public observation APIs; publication is separate from research adoption.

public.eligibility: Named adoption review explicitly confirms public_fields_reviewed=true. This confirms the allowlisted research fields, not permission to republish the whole source. No additional owner confirmation per batch.
public.ordinary_source_eligibility: Stable typed identity and structural registration only; status unverified. The same public allowlist applies without factual/C3 adoption review. Quotes, archived paths and receiver provenance remain internal.

subscriber.purpose: Future paid research access requires separate server-side entitlements. Existing internal member roles are not paid subscriptions. Source distribution permissions still apply.

internal.purpose: Originals, full quotations, local provenance paths and operational/review audit remain internal unless separately approved for distribution. Never expose credentials through research APIs.
